title: Isandro and the Letters
author: Isandro Nakamura
blurb: Wendell Thornbury, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
